Existing capture.operations solution.free_ids may be used when an operation is emitted; capture.refusal.free_ids may be the fallback only when no operation exists. The control must prove that the chosen record is the first face, rather than silently accepting a later pivot/refinement face. findings.finding: The captured-G4 helper attaches the synthetic diagonal-fixture provenance [0,1,2,3,4,5] and synthetic areas/wet fractions. The real upper role coordinates are 0,1,2 and lower role coordinates are 6,7,8; the preserved capture also records distinct physical areas and lower wet fraction.
